source.title: Validare la sintassi dei launcher Codex prima dell'avvio
source.objective: Codex CLI automation wrapper accepted --search only as a global option before exec; placing --search after codex exec caused immediate exit code 2 and killed the tmux job before work began. Harden long-running launcher/wrapper generation to validate option placement against the installed Codex CLI or use codex --search exec consistently.
